name: Mark Renumber Planner
description: Read-only check of door, room and window marks in a saved snapshot: duplicate marks, empty marks, gaps and out-of-order sequences. Proposes a new numbering from a small rule file (doors: To room number plus a letter; rooms: level prefix plus sequence; windows: same as rooms). A second command drafts one plan of parameter writes for human approval and refuses if the final numbering would hold a duplicate. This module never writes to the model.
author: AEC Model Bridge
